supportingSources.label: Kineticist Star God rules and machine guide

strategy.overview: Star God links S-T-A-R, G-O-D, and the left drop bank. Complete the S-T-A-R rollovers to light the black target for its award. Repeated completions of the eight upper-right targets spell G-O-D; completing G-O-D lights the red Special target. Each completion of the four left drop targets raises Bonus X from 2x through 5x. The spinner scores more when its lamp is lit.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete the S-T-A-R rollovers, then hit the lit black target. Complete the eight upper-right targets three times to spell G-O-D, then hit the red target for Special. Complete the four left drop targets repeatedly to raise Bonus X from 2x to 5x, and shoot the spinner while it is lit.
strategy.summary: Finish the target group closest to completion. Use S-T-A-R for the black-target award, repeat the upper-right set for G-O-D and Special, and keep returning to the left bank until Bonus X reaches 5x.

quickInfo.name: Spell S-T-A-R
quickInfo.summary: Complete the top and left-canal rollovers.

quickInfo.name: Spell G-O-D
quickInfo.summary: Complete the eight upper-right targets three times.

quickInfo.name: Collect Special
quickInfo.summary: Hit the red target after G-O-D.

quickInfo.name: Raise Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete the four left drops repeatedly.

steps.text: Complete the S-T-A-R rollovers to light the black target, then hit that target for its displayed award.
Complete the eight upper-right targets once for G, again for O, and a third time for D.
After G-O-D is complete, hit the lit red target to collect Special.
Complete the four left drop targets repeatedly to advance Bonus X from 2x to 5x; use the spinner while its higher value is lit.

alternatives.title: Build Bonus X first
alternatives.when: Use this when the left drop bank is partly down.

steps.text: Finish the four-target bank for the next Bonus X step.
Return to S-T-A-R or the upper-right targets after the bank resets.
Finish full sets of the eight upper-right targets rather than leaving several partial routes.
After the third set, prioritize the red Special target.

machineSetup: Check Bonus X, black-target awards, G-O-D difficulty, spinner values, and Special awards.
Test every S-T-A-R rollover, all eight upper-right targets, black and red targets, four left drops, spinner, and progress lamps.

cautions.issue: The black and red targets can award different values by setup.
cautions.response: Use their lamps and award card rather than assuming a replay or extra ball.
